entries.text: Approval column in the table view, with Approve and Reject buttons for approvers.
Approval can be hidden per view from Display properties.
Report mode in the Division Dashboard: tasks completed per period, with CSV download.
Done work items can be archived automatically after a set number of days (default 90).
New look: warm backgrounds, new fonts and softer 3D buttons.
Personal display preferences: color scheme, font, glow, button style and animation.
Chat: Announcements and Changelog channels for everyone, plus activity cards with buttons.
Chat: calls now leave a log in the conversation with a Call back button.
Chat: browse and join channels, and manage names, topics and members from channel settings.
Chat: see who is online, away or offline.
Paste or drag files into chat, comments and descriptions to attach them.
Notification volume slider with a Preview button in Profile > Preferences.
Click any member to see their profile: department, email, phone extension and a Send message button.
Emails have a new Paradise Perkasa design and follow your language setting.
The sign-in page has a new look.
Super Admins in a department can now be mentioned, assigned and used in filters.
Mentions now find people by their full name.
Profile pictures now show in emails.
An enlarged image can always be zoomed out and closed, and Back closes it.
Reactions now work on other people's channel messages.
Approval emails now say clearly whether you need to decide or your work was decided.
Super Admins placed in a department or division now appear in that division's projects.
Table rows alternate in shade so long lists are easier to read.
Actions that used to appear only on hover now work on phones, tablets and the keyboard.
Deleting a chat message, leaving a channel or deleting a Wiki file now asks for confirmation.
Boards and task edits load faster for managers.
Chat no longer jumps away from the latest message while images load.
Long channel names and links no longer push buttons off the screen on phones.
Rejection reasons are shown under the approval queue row, not only in a tooltip.
The sidebar groups projects by division only, without repeating the department name.
Every department always gets its own project, even when its code clashes with an existing one.
The Changelog channel now includes notes from earlier releases.
Email accent lines follow the rounded corners, and buttons no longer show an underline.
Profile: job title is picked from the department list.
Chat: replies show a WhatsApp-style quote, and incoming messages show the sender name.
Member profile card always shows the phone extension, or says it is not set.
Chat messages can only be deleted within 24 hours of sending. Super Admins can change the limit in God Mode > Features.
Command palette (Ctrl+K): jump to Chat, Wiki, Division Dashboard, Stickies, Quick links, your calendar and a project's Approvals, or open any account setting.
Command palette no longer lists Cycles, Billing or the old Documentation shortcut.
Chat: type @ to mention someone in the conversation. In channels, the person you mention also gets a card in their Paradise chat.
Chat: every division and department has its own private channel. Members follow the organization chart in God Mode, so moving someone moves their channels too.
Browser notifications for chat messages and work updates, even when Paradise is behind another window. Turn them on or off and send a test from the sound button in Chat or Notifications.
Chat no longer plays the notification sound when you open a system channel or switch conversations.
Comment, mention and update cards now reach your Paradise chat.
